title: Karbobala ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho
body:
Haider×5
(Karbobala Ke Haider (Awaz Do Kaha Ho)×2)×3
Bazmo wafa Ke Paikar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
1.Tanha Khada Huwai Hu Awaz De Raha Hu
Majbooriyo Mai Dekho Ban Tera Sehara Hu
Kehta Hu Tum Se Rokar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
2.Akbar Rahe Na Qasim Jaan Apne Kho Chukaye Hai
Asgar Bhi Teer Kha Kar Maqtal Mein So Chukaye Hai
Hai Aun Or Na Jaffar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
3.Jo Khoof Se Tumhare Raato Ko Jagate The
Wehshat Zada Wo Zalim Ghabra Ke Bhagte The
Soyenge Ab Wo Sitamgar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
4.Bekass Ke Tum Thay Wali Zainab Ka Aasera Dekh
Kulsoom Ke Sahare Bacho Pe Tum Fida The
Soyenge Ab Wo Kyunkar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
5.Darya Se Panni Lawyo Itna Kaha Tha Maine
Mashkeeza Ek Alaam He Tumko Diya Tha Maine
Saqa-e- Ibne Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
6.Dete Wo Tummay Darya Ahle Jafa Se Cheena
Panni Ka Koi Shikwa Karte Nahi Sakina
Marjaye Na Tadap Kar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
7.Gir Gir Ke Uth Raha Ho Mere Kamar Kyu Tuti
Itna Zara Batado Kyun Zindagi Yeh Roothi
Tum Kho Gaye Baradar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
8.Ghazi Ke Pass Pohchu Sarwaar Ke Jostu Ju Hai
Bhai Abhi Hai Zinda Chera Lahu Lahu Hai
Kya Hogaya Baradar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
9.Bola Jaree Ke Hasrat Hai Dil Mein Mere Moula
Aankhon Se Teer Nikle Dekho Main Tumko Aaqa
Wo Dekho Mahe Anwar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
10.Phir Bole Sheh Aye Bhaiya Ek Mere Jostu Ju Hai
Ek Baar Keh Do Bhaiye Yeh Dil Ke Aarazo Hai
Tum Nikle Bhai Kehkar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha
Ho ×2
<<DIVIDER>>
11. Abbas Ne Likha Hai Purdard Jo Yeh Nauha
Hai Saheeb-e- Alam Yeh Manzar Jo Karbala Ka
Roya Kalam Bhi Likhkar Awaz Do Kaha Ho
Karbobala Ke Haider Awaz Do Kaha Ho ×2
